SAID PLAINLY: EVERY ID BELOW WAS CHOSEN FROM catalogue.json METADATA

in the reasoned category is included, so the contact sheet after this
run has already seen everything worth seeing and the choice needs no
second CI round trip.

METAL -> ALL 100 Metal ids (strict 'Metal###', Metal032 the current pick
